description: This file defines a report parser class for generating buyer list reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module related to auctions, including methods for retrieving auction lot data, calculating totals, and integrating with report rendering.

classes.name: buyer_list
classes.description: Report parser class for buyer list, providing methods to gather auction lot data and totals for report generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper functions and data.

methods.name: lines_lots_from_auction
methods.description: Retrieves auction lot IDs from objects, fetches related auction date info and buyer taxes, and returns a list of auction date data with total tax amounts.

methods.name: lines_lots_auct_lot
methods.description: Fetches auction lot details grouped by auction date and login, updates total sum variables, and returns the result set.

methods.name: sum_buyer_obj_price
methods.description: Returns total buyer object price sum.
